description: A friendly pocket-sized robot co-pilot in a children's space game. MALE. A boy's voice, or a young man's - clearly masculine, never feminine or androgynous. Thin, bright and slightly tinny, like a small speaker inside a metal shell. Mid-pitch for a male voice, not high. Calm and matter-of-fact, gently mechanical cadence with even pacing. Speaks to a child as an equal and never talks down. CLEAN and NATURAL above all: no breathiness, no wobble, no artefacts.
text: Asteroid belt ahead. Rocks with words on them. Type the word, the blaster does the rest. Ready when you are.
